knowledge:
- key_parameters: m=GRanges object containing methylation data (T and M counts) ;; seqLengths=Named vector containing chromosome lengths of the reference genome ;; chr.sel=Chromosome selected for training/plotting (typically a small autosome to minimize computing time and avoid sex-specific biases) ;; num.cores=Number of cores for parallel processing (only available on Unix/Mac) ;; meth.cutoff=Methylation cutoff (e.g., 0.5) used to distinguish UMRs/LMRs ;; nCpG.cutoff=Minimum number of CpGs in a region to call it a UMR/LMR, determined via FDR ;; PMDs=GRanges object of PMD segments, used to mask PMD regions during UMR/LMR detection ;; myGenomeSeq=BSgenome object of the reference genome
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing whole-genome bisulfite-sequencing (Bis-seq) datasets with a minimal genome-wide coverage of 10X to identify regulatory regions (UMRs/LMRs) and large disordered methylation regions (PMDs).
- pitfalls: Do NOT use for datasets with lower than 10X genome-wide coverage ;; Failing to set a random seed (set.seed) can lead to slightly different results due to random permutations in FDR calculations ;; Failing to remove CpGs overlapping SNPs when the genomic background of the sample differs from the reference genome ;; Running parallel processing (num.cores > 1) on non-Unix/Mac systems (e.g., Windows) is not supported ;; Not visually inspecting the PMD segmentation or alpha distribution to confirm bimodality before running PMD segmentation.

workflows.name: bis_seq_methylation_segmentation
workflows.intent: Identify partially methylated domains (PMDs), unmethylated regions (UMRs), and lowly methylated regions (LMRs) from Bis-seq methylation data with SNP filtering and FDR control.
input: Lister2009_imr90_hg38_chr22.tab (Tab-delimited file with four columns: chromosome, position, T, and M)
SNVs_hg38_chr22.tab (Tab-delimited text file with two columns: chromosome and position of SNPs)
workflows.stages: 1. Load reference genome sequence lengths ;; 2. Import methylation data using readMethylome ;; 3. Import SNP table using readSNPTable and filter out SNP-overlapping CpGs using removeSNPs ;; 4. Assess PMD presence by plotting alpha distribution using plotAlphaDistributionOneChr ;; 5. Segment PMDs using segmentPMDs and visualize segmentation using plotPMDSegmentation ;; 6. Calculate False Discovery Rates (FDRs) for UMR/LMR calling using calculateFDRs ;; 7. Segment UMRs and LMRs using segmentUMRsLMRs and visualize final segmentation using plotFinalSegmentation
workflows.code:
library(MethylSeekR)
set.seed(123)
library("BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38")
sLengths=seqlengths(Hsapiens)
methFname <- system.file("extdata", 
"Lister2009_imr90_hg38_chr22.tab", package="MethylSeekR")
meth.gr <- readMethylome(FileName=methFname, seqLengths=sLengths)
snpFname <- system.file("extdata", "SNVs_hg38_chr22.tab",
package="MethylSeekR")
snps.gr <- readSNPTable(FileName=snpFname, seqLengths=sLengths)
meth.gr <- removeSNPs(meth.gr, snps.gr)
plotAlphaDistributionOneChr(m=meth.gr, chr.sel="chr22", 
num.cores=1)
PMDsegments.gr <- segmentPMDs(m=meth.gr, chr.sel="chr22", 
seqLengths=sLengths, num.cores=1)
plotAlphaDistributionOneChr(m=subsetByOverlaps(meth.gr, 
PMDsegments.gr[values(PMDsegments.gr)$type=="notPMD"]), chr.sel="chr22", 
num.cores=1)
plotPMDSegmentation(m=meth.gr, segs=PMDsegments.gr)
library(rtracklayer)
session <- browserSession()
genome(session) <- "hg38"
query <- ucscTableQuery(session, table = "cpgIslandExt")
CpGislands.gr <- track(query)
genome(CpGislands.gr) <- NA
CpGislands.gr <- 
suppressWarnings(resize(CpGislands.gr, 5000, fix="center"))
stats <- calculateFDRs(m=meth.gr, CGIs=CpGislands.gr,
PMDs=PMDsegments.gr, num.cores=1)
FDR.cutoff <- 5 
m.sel <- 0.5 
n.sel=as.integer(names(stats$FDRs[as.character(m.sel), ]
[stats$FDRs[as.character(m.sel), ]<FDR.cutoff])[1])
UMRLMRsegments.gr <- segmentUMRsLMRs(m=meth.gr, meth.cutoff=m.sel,
nCpG.cutoff=n.sel, PMDs=PMDsegments.gr, 
num.cores=1, myGenomeSeq=Hsapiens, 
seqLengths=sLengths)
plotFinalSegmentation(m=meth.gr, segs=UMRLMRsegments.gr,
PMDs=PMDsegments.gr,meth.cutoff=m.sel)
